description: This file defines an abstract class CombinedDisplayField within the namespace OrangeHRM\Core\Report\DisplayField. The class appears to serve as a base for creating composite display fields for reporting purposes, with methods to retrieve DTO class names, entity aliases, and fields, and to generate a SELECT statement part for database queries.

classes.name: CombinedDisplayField
classes.description: An abstract base class for composite report display fields, providing a template for subclasses to specify DTO classes, entity aliases, and fields, and to generate a select part for database queries.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Final constructor for the class, no specific initialization logic.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Abstract method to return the class name of the Data Transfer Object associated with the display field.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Abstract method to return an array of entity alias strings used in database queries.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Abstract method to return an array of field names that will be used to construct the select part.

methods.name: getSelectPart
methods.description: Returns a string representing a part of a SQL SELECT statement to instantiate a DTO with specified fields.
